def test_digitSum():
    # Empty string returns 0
    assert digitSum("") == 0

    # All uppercase letters
    assert digitSum("A") == 65
    assert digitSum("ABC") == ord('A') + ord('B') + ord('C')  # 65 + 66 + 67 = 198
    assert digitSum("Z") == 90

    # All lowercase letters contribute 0
    assert digitSum("abc") == 0
    assert digitSum("z") == 0

    # Mixed case
    assert digitSum("aA") == 65
    assert digitSum("Ab") == 65
    assert digitSum("Hello World") == ord('H') + ord('W')  # 72 + 87 = 159

    # Digits and special characters are not uppercase, contribute 0
    assert digitSum("123!@#") == 0
    assert digitSum("a1B2") == ord('B')  # 66

    # Whitespace is not uppercase
    assert digitSum(" A ") == 65

    # Unicode uppercase characters
    assert digitSum("É") == ord('É')

    # Long mixed string
    assert digitSum("The Quick Brown Fox") == (
        ord('T') + ord('Q') + ord('B') + ord('F')
    )  # 84 + 81 + 66 + 70 = 301

    print("All tests passed!")

def test_digitSum():
    # Empty string returns 0
    assert digitSum("") == 0

    # All uppercase letters
    assert digitSum("ABC") == 65 + 66 + 67  # 198

    # Mixed case: only uppercase contribute
    assert digitSum("abAB") == ord('A') + ord('B')  # 131
    assert digitSum("abcCd") == ord('C')  # 67
    assert digitSum("aAaaaXa") == ord('A') + ord('X')  # 153
    assert digitSum("aBCde") == ord('B') + ord('C')  # 133

    # All lowercase returns 0
    assert digitSum("abcdef") == 0

    # Single uppercase character
    assert digitSum("Z") == ord('Z')  # 90

    # Non-letter characters (not uppercase) contribute 0
    assert digitSum(" ") == 0
    assert digitSum("123") == 0
    assert digitSum("!@#") == 0

    # Mixed letters, digits, and symbols
    assert digitSum("a1B!cD") == ord('B') + ord('D')  # 134

    # String with only one uppercase among many chars
    assert digitSum("hello World") == ord('W')  # 87

    print("All test_digitSum tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_digitSum()
